audit.rooflightLoss: before 005X a rooflight existed only if a render showed a light patch in the roof plane of a registered view (readRooflights). The plan's rooflight callouts were never read: the metric ring reader needs ink, and these rings are a faint grey line (~170) round a paper disc (~231) on a tinted knee-wall strip (~210). A01: 0 of 7 callout rings read; the front band view gave 2 rooflights, the rear band view does not pass the wall check, the third front one sits under the watermark.

reconstruction readPlanRooflights: a coherent callout with a bar, inside the storey under a gable, of a rooflight's size -> a rooflight on the slope it stands under, centred on the callout along the ridge, the stated length foreshortened by the pitch up the slope; position up the slope an uncertainty
